advancements.strata_epochs.root.title: Strata: Deep Time
jei.strata_bridge.info.core_drill: Right-click the ground to drill a core sample. It shows which epoch lies beneath this region (8×8 chunks). Epochs lie at different depths: tier 1 (Core Drill) reaches the Crystal Age, tier 2 (Crystal Core Drill) also the Spore Age, tier 3 (Deep Core Drill) also the Ash Age.
jei.strata_bridge.info.core_sample: Shows an epoch. Right-click an Epoch Gate with it to travel there. The sample is used up.
jei.strata_bridge.info.epoch_gate: Right-click with a core sample to enter its epoch. Inside an epoch, right-click the gate twice to return; sneak + right-click takes a bearing on the epoch's biomes. Gates inside epochs cannot be broken.
jei.strata_bridge.info.time_anchor: Keep it in your inventory to double the time you can stay in an epoch before you solidify.
jei.strata_bridge.info.petrified_stone: Forms around players who stay too long in an epoch.
jade.strata_bridge.gate.enter: Right-click with a core sample to travel
jade.strata_bridge.gate.leave: Right-click twice to return home · Sneak: take a biome bearing
advancements.strata_epochs.met_geode_cra: Meet a Geode Crawler. Follow it to find ore.
advancements.strata_epochs.met_spore_bel: Meet a Spore Bellows. Its clouds make time run faster.
advancements.strata_epochs.met_petrified: Meet a Petrified Witness. Stay too long and you turn to stone.
Read a codex fragment from a Petrified Witness.
jade.strata_bridge.mob.geode_crawler: Crystal Age · neutral, leads to ore
jade.strata_bridge.mob.spore_bellows: Spore Age · spores speed up solidification
jade.strata_bridge.mob.petrified_witness: Echo of a traveller · a pickaxe breaks its stone skin
jei.strata_bridge.info.calcite_scale: Dropped by the Geode Crawler (Crystal Age). Material for geode armor and a second time anchor recipe.
jei.strata_bridge.info.spore_sac: Dropped by the Spore Bellows (Spore Age). Ingredient for the germ tonic and the amber blade.
jei.strata_bridge.info.germ_tonic: Right-click inside an epoch: turns the solidification clock back by 60 seconds.
jei.strata_bridge.info.codex_fragment: Dropped by the Petrified Witness. Right-click unlocks the codex node "Echo of a Traveller".
jei.strata_bridge.info.amber_blade: A sword of amber. Every melee hit slows the target for 2 seconds.
jei.strata_bridge.info.geode_armor: Slightly stronger than iron. With all four pieces, solidification in epochs runs 25% slower.
jei.strata_bridge.info.ember_ore: Found in the Ash Age. Needs an iron pickaxe.
jei.strata_bridge.info.ember_shard: Burns in a furnace as long as a blaze rod.
advancements.strata_epochs.mastered_crys: The Crystal Age is complete in the codex. The Transplanter can bring it to the Overworld
advancements.strata_epochs.mastered_spor: The Spore Age is complete in the codex. The Transplanter can bring it to the Overworld
advancements.strata_epochs.mastered_ash_: The Ash Age is complete in the codex. The Transplanter can bring it to the Overworld
jei.strata_bridge.info.fossil_chunk: Fossil chunks drop in epochs from Chronostone (2%) and Petrified Stone (15%). To prepare one: chisel in main hand, chunk in off hand, right-click the Preparation Table. Five strokes uncover the fossil. Striking too fast risks up to 30% breakage per stroke; with about a second's pause it is only 3%.
jei.strata_bridge.info.fossil: A prepared fossil. The first one of an epoch completes it in the codex; the Transplanter uses one per run.
jei.strata_bridge.info.ammonite_fossil: A prepared fossil from the Crystal Age; the first one completes the epoch in the codex. Ammonite in main hand, Germ Tonic in off hand, right-click the Preparation Table: a Spiralit hatches (one per player). It floats at your right, its spiral shows the time left in the epoch (four segments, one per quarter), solidification runs 20% slower near it (does not stack with Geode armor), and every 15 s it points at a nearby epoch ore. Sneak + right-click: stay/follow; Crystal Quartz heals it.
Revive an Ammonite with Germ Tonic
advancements.strata_epochs.first_transpl: Bring an epoch to the Overworld with the Transplanter
jei.strata_bridge.info.transplanter: Right-click with a core sample to permanently turn the surroundings (radius 12, configurable) into that epoch: rock, surface, biome, then giant mushrooms, geodes or basalt columns grow. Requires the epoch to be explored (visited and a fossil prepared). Uses the core sample and one fossil of the epoch. Only natural blocks change, builds stay. Overworld only.
advancements.strata_epochs.first_analysi: Analyze a core sample at the Core Analysis Table
jei.strata_bridge.info.analysis_table: Right-click with core samples to analyze the stack. The note on the core shows depth, time limit, finds and whether the epoch is explored for the Transplanter. Entering an epoch with an analyzed core gives 25% more time before solidification. Hoppers and pipes: push cores in, analyzed cores go to the inventory below.
advancements.strata_epochs.met_ember_bur: Encounter the Ember Burrower in the Ash Age
jade.strata_bridge.mob.ember_burrower: Ash Age · burrows in ash, solid ground protects
jei.strata_bridge.info.quartz_thistle_se: Quartz Thistle (Crystal Age), grows on calcite, amethyst or packed ice. Ancient seeds are sometimes hidden in fossil chunks (35% when preparing). They only grow in a biome of their epoch: in the epoch itself or on ground the Transplanter turned into it. They need no light and bone meal does not work; they ripen in about 17 minutes. Ripe, they give one Crystal Quartz and 1–2 seeds (Fortune gives more).
jei.strata_bridge.info.resin_fern_spores: Resin Fern (Spore Age), grows on mycelium, moss, mud or warped nylium. Ancient seeds are sometimes hidden in fossil chunks (35% when preparing). They only grow in a biome of their epoch: in the epoch itself or on ground the Transplanter turned into it. They need no light and bone meal does not work; they ripen in about 17 minutes. Ripe, they give one Amber Shard and 1–2 seeds (Fortune gives more).
jei.strata_bridge.info.ember_tuber: Ember Tuber (Ash Age), grows on volcanic ash, blackstone or soul soil and glows a little when ripe. Ancient seeds are sometimes hidden in fossil chunks (35% when preparing). They only grow in a biome of their epoch: in the epoch itself or on ground the Transplanter turned into it. They need no light and bone meal does not work; they ripen in about 17 minutes. Ripe, they give one Ember Shard and 1–2 seeds (Fortune gives more).
jei.strata_bridge.info.petrified_item: Once you are solidifying in an epoch, your inventory follows the blocks: every 20 s a stack turns into a petrified item, first from your backpack, then your hotbar, never your main hand. The original is safe inside but cannot be used. It comes loose by itself as soon as its carrier is no longer solidifying: go back through the gate, drink a Germ Tonic, or on death. Other players' lumps only come loose outside the epochs. Time Anchors and Germ Tonics never petrify, and neither do armor or the off hand.
advancements.strata_epochs.sealed_rift.d: Seal a time rift with a Time Anchor
advancements.strata_epochs.museum.title: Museum of Earth History
advancements.strata_epochs.museum.descri: Display the whole primeval collection in display cases close together (15 exhibits)
jei.strata_bridge.info.display_case: Display Case (glass, chronostone, gold): right-click with an item to display one, right-click with an empty hand to take it out; on an empty case it shows the museum's progress. Breaking it drops the exhibit. The collection: per epoch a core sample, fossil, resource and plant, plus a Calcite Scale, Spore Sac and Codex Fragment (15 exhibits) in display cases within 12 blocks. A complete museum gives 10% more time in every epoch, permanently.
jei.strata_bridge.info.time_essence: Condensed time. Drops when you seal a time rift (1–2) and with 50% from the Petrified Witness when a player defeats it. Right-click an epoch plant: all epoch plants in the 3×3 area grow one stage for one essence (bone meal does not work on them). Packs and magic mods find it in the item tag strata_epochs:time_essence.
